p: aloud: The Lord thus speaks to the prophet willing him to use all diligence and severity to rebuke the hypocrites.
seek me daily: They will seem to worship me and have outward holiness.
Why have we fasted: He sets forth the malice and disdain of the hypocrites, who grudge against God, if their works are not accepted.
pleasure: Thus he convinces the hypocrites by the second table and by their duty toward their neighbour, that they have neither faith nor religion.
heard on high: So long as you use contention and oppression, your fasting and prayers will not be heard.
yoke: That you leave off all your extortions.
thy own flesh: For in him you see yourself as in a mirror.
That is, the prosperous estate with which God will bless you.
righteousness shall go before thee: The testimony of your goodness will appear before God and man.
finger: By which is meant all manner of injury.
draw out thy soul to the: That is, have compassion on their miseries.
obscurity: Your adversity will be turned into prosperity.

waste places: Signifying that of the Jews would come such as would build again the ruins of Jerusalem and Judea: but chiefly this is meant of the spiritual Jerusalem, whose builders were the Apostles.
turn away thy foot from the: If you refrain yourself from your wicked works.
